data.body: Implemented in-tree architecture projection (docs/architecture-projection.md). The design DB stays canonical; Adashi renders bounded byte-stable managed blocks into the project root instruction file and every folder with file bindings. Opt-in per project, name configurable (default AGENTS.md), budgets enforced on the whole block (2 KB root, 1 KB folder) because nested instruction files compete for a harness budget that deletes on overflow. Drift is detected without stored digests: a block whose embedded revision matches but whose text differs from a fresh render was edited outside Adashi. Prerequisites fixed: the design schema no longer marks maxDepth/childrenDepth/limit required, and prompt_hygiene rewrites stored prompts naming removed tools, reporting unmapped references as dashboard warnings. Gap: regeneration is driven by the resident desktop app, so an MCP design save while Adashi is closed leaves a folder block stale until the next load.
